cases.title: Mild familiar headache
cases.scenario: Fictional adult selects a familiar occasional mild headache, under 24 hours, improving, normal hydration and no listed risks or warning signs.

software_output.assessment: Self-care and monitoring may be reasonable
software_output.advice:
You reported a short-lived, mild, improving symptom pattern, no listed warning signs or health risks, and normal fluid intake.

Based on the limited answers provided, home care and monitoring may be reasonable for now. This is not medical clearance, a diagnosis, or proof that a clinic visit is unnecessary. You can still contact the clinic at any time.

Reported symptom pattern: Familiar mild headache. This does not identify the cause.

Drink water, eat regular meals, relax, and take breaks from screens.

Recheck how you feel later today and tomorrow. Contact the clinic if symptoms are not improving, persist, return, or worry you. Seek prompt medical help for worsening symptoms, fever, trouble drinking, less urine, or new dizziness. Seek emergency help for breathing difficulty, collapse, confusion, sudden severe pain, or other emergency signs.
